purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S2_resolution_refinements. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py from campaign_matrix.json (entries verbatim, matrix order). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md. NOT RUNNABLE (HOLD): see not_runnable_reason.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES; it does not apply any stop rule below. The main session reads results/campaigns/<plan>.json and analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/post_run_checks.py output after each plan and decides.
stop_rules: HOLD: Register amendment A41 (2026-10-13; added to register-rev2-frozen-20261010T1833Z after the freeze, not part of the frozen 26-launch diagnostic set): S0-02-DOS2 runs only from campaign_C10_DIAGb (the S2-11 rerun, then S0-02-DOS2), after A41 and the resolution-method sign-off are logged and Codex has reviewed A41. Matched oxide-mesh refinements under the frozen A41 trigger get their own plan only after the trigger has fired and is logged.

A41: S0-02-DOS2 (run_0067 settings, DOS 768/384) is the I_G resolution pair for S2-11 (score_register.py resolution_pair <S0-02-DOS2 run> <run_0067> ig_raw_A); it shares run_0067 with the S2-11 comparison (recorded, never independent). A non-qualifying pair leaves S2-11 PROVISIONAL; no second DOS run.
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and refuses runnable=false plans

Its I_G comparison with run_0067 (score_register.py resolution_pair <this run> <run_0067> ig_raw_A) is the candidate I_G ceiling for hc_mesh <S2-11 rerun> <run_0067>; the shared run_0067 baseline is recorded as NOT independent. Numerical stability under the DOS intervention only, not an absolute error bound (ASSUMED operational method).
